Foundation Panel 的修复更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A fix update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 修复「主机设置」左侧分类和设置搜索显示内部键名而不是文字的问题。
  Fixed host settings categories and settings search showing internal key names instead of text.
- 文案缺失时显示基础语言文字，不再显示键名。
  Missing texts now fall back to the base language instead of showing key names.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
